thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: Canary failure detected for hosted/text-gen-1 — 5xx rate 7% (+6ppt over baseline) in the last 3m. Auto-canary policy flagged. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/canary/abc123
Alice: ack, I'm oncall. Pulling logs and attaching.
deploy-bot: Rollout started 2024-04-05T03:40Z commit abc123 -> text-gen-1 at 10% traffic.
Ben: seeing repeats in pod logs: `quantize_kernel: illegal memory access` on infer-0 pods, stacktrace attached.
Carla: likely the 4-bit quant kernel path. We saw a similar failure on canary last quarter. Suggest flipping `runtime.quant_use_legacy` for canary traffic to force fallback.
Dave: I can toggle the flag now. Running: `rbacctl set-flag runtime.quant_use_legacy true --env canary`
Dave: Flag flipped. Restarting canary pods: ``kubectl rollout restart ds/text-gen-canary -n prod-canary``
Eve: after restart (~60s) 5xx dropped to ~0.9%. p50 latency up ~30ms but errors gone. Monitoring. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Auto-kill not executed because policy `allow-redress` is enabled. Observing for 10m before further action.
Carla: kernel selection logic chooses quantized kernels for sequence lengths >256; this can hit an untested codepath. We'll collect traces.
Ben: adding log excerpt:
```stderr
quantize_kernel: illegal memory access at 0x7fffa3b0
Backtrace:
 0x55ab3f kernel_dispatch
 0x55ab8a runtime_entry
```
Alice: good catch. For safety, we have a rollback ready if errors or latencies creep back up. Rollback command: `deploy rollback --service text-gen-1 --to sha=abc890`
Kim-CS: any customer impact? Are embeddings or other endpoints affected?
Eve: embeddings and rerankers unaffected. Impact limited to text-gen-1 canary path; global user-facing impact estimated ~0.3% at peak.
deploy-bot: Manual rollback initiated by Dave at 03:47Z -> target sha=abc890. Draining canary and shifting traffic.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 03:50Z. text-gen-1 running previous variant; canary removed from rotation.
incident-bot: Incident update: degraded canary window ~10m. Elevated 5xx only on canary shards. Customer impact: small subset of requests for 6% of canary traffic, global ~0.3%. Postmortem required.
Carla: opening tracking issue infra/eng-runtime #4521 with kernel traces, config diffs, and flamegraphs. Tagging eng-sre and runtime.
Ben: uploading extra logs and a short reproducer for the quant path.
Alice: handing off monitoring to night oncall Sam for 12:00-20:00UTC. Sam, pls pick up follow-ups (link to issue above).
Sam: ack — I'll monitor dashboards and coordinate any follow-ups.
Dave: recommendation: set kill-switch default to safe for next rollouts and add kernel fallback in runtime to avoid selecting unverified quant kernels. Also suggest adding a short e2e test on 4-bit path.
Alice: thanks. I'll post a short incident note to #general and notify PMs. @Kim-CS please prepare a brief customer note stating limited canary impact and no action required.
Kim-CS: will draft and post: "Minor degradation limited to our canary; no customer action required."
incident-bot: Thread closed by Alice — follow-ups assigned to eng-runtime and eng-sre. Postmortem due by EOD tomorrow.
